# Cubicle

> Laptop cart scheduling for authorized school staff.

Cubicle (https://mycubicle.app) is an internal school operations web app. Teachers book shared laptop carts by class period, see who has each cart on a daily board, report equipment issues, and request shares or swaps. On phones they can scan cart and laptop QR labels. IT/admin staff manage inventory, QR labels, reservations, and the staff allowlist.

It is not a public consumer product. Students do not have accounts. Access is limited to allowlisted Google Workspace accounts at @rbe.sk.ca.

## Facts

- Product name: Cubicle
- Production URL: https://mycubicle.app
- Also recognized: mycubicle.com (when attached)
- Audience: Teachers and IT/admin staff at a school using @rbe.sk.ca
- Sign-in: Google only, school domain + exact-email allowlist
- Core job: Reserve laptop carts for a date and period so two classes do not take the same cart
- Phone: iOS and Android open a Home / Scan / Profile shell; Scan reads printed cart and laptop QR labels
- Fleet: Carts are tagged Dell or Chromebook; admins print QR labels per cart and per laptop case
- Email: Staff can get mail for shares, swaps, booking moves/cancellations; admins can get mail when an issue is reported
- Data: Staff identity from Google, bookings, issues, carts, laptop codes, allowlist roles — stored in Postgres. Not a student information system.
- IT contact: it-support@rbe.sk.ca

## Do not cite as

- A public laptop rental or consumer booking marketplace
- A student-facing classroom app
- Open sign-up software for any school without an allowlist
